area_boundary: same native COCO inclusive area intervals; boundary GT may appear twice; never sum size denominators
GT: original bridge retained category1..10, raw score>0, raw area; score0 crowd retained as ignored matching targets
geometry: continuous xyxy FP64 IoU, class-agnostic and correct-class best separately; raw queries without score/candidate selection also reported
matching: per image/class/area score-ordered COCO evaluateImg semantics: nonignored GT first, max-IoU eligible unmatched GT, later GT wins exact IoU ties, crowd intersection/detection-area, crowd reusable; diagnostic at only .50/.75, no AP/AR accumulation
order: production stable descending FP32 score then view/query/category; classwise NMS sorts before suppression and preserves global order; sorting deletes no boxes
counterfactuals: B/C full 2x2x2 factorial: original NMS on/off, global600 budget on/off, per-class100 evaluation cap on/off; always rerank surviving candidates and rerun raw-ignore and complete matching. Scores/boxes unchanged. A original reference only. No new NMS thresholds or oracle candidate insertion.
matching_competition_check: maximum-cardinality correct-class bipartite coverage at .50/.75 on final nonignored candidates vs noncrowd in-area GT; offline upper-bound only, not a deployable prediction or metric
transitions: all adjacent stages and A-to-B, A-to-C, B-to-C: retained/new/lost/recovered identities; geometry nonincreasing in nested sets, greedy one-to-one can recover under deletion
summaries: all sequences including zero relevant GT, all ten classes, three native area ranges, both IoUs; target-weighted and unweighted valid-sequence rates; no new bootstrap
cases: at most one lowest lexicographic(image_id,raw_annotation_id) case per A-to-B/A-to-C/B-to-C large lost/gained path at each IoU; all counts reported, no image loading
decision: a researchable source requires >=10 lost large GT at a threshold, one stage accounting for >=50% of reference-lost large GT, and a matching rerun showing net large recovery for a relevant factor at both IoUs; report small/medium tradeoffs rather than declaring AP benefit. Without consistent intervention evidence close this direction. This heuristic selects follow-up discussion, never regrades original science gates.
limits: single seed repeatedly used development; only two IoUs, not original averaged/macro AR; first disappearance not unique cause; no heldout/external validation or causal training explanation
